note: Thailand's largest card issuers are the big banks' card arms: Krungthai Card (KTC, of Krungthai Bank), Kasikornbank, Siam Commercial Bank, Bangkok Bank and Krungsri. Kasikornbank's pages answer a bot challenge (2026-10-29), Siam Commercial Bank's rates-and-fees PDF and Krungsri's card pages answer Incapsula's block, and Bangkok Bank's and Krungsri Card's sites didn't answer (no connection, 2026-10-30); none of those is passed or worked around, so only KTC is written. KTC's table of interest, fees and other service charges (effective 1 January 2026, read again 2026-10-30): interest on every card 16% a year, on purchases from the posting date and on cash from the day it's drawn, with up to 45 days free on purchases when the statement is paid in full; the minimum payment 10% of the statement or at least 500 baht; the Visa Infinite, World Mastercard and UnionPay Asia Prestige Diamond take no minimum payment (written as charge cards); the primary card's annual fee 5,000 baht for the Visa Infinite, World Mastercard, KTC X Visa Signature and KTC X World Rewards Mastercard and 10,000 for the UnionPay Asia Prestige Diamond; every other card has no annual fee for a single card (written as the KTC Credit Card this file has held since 2026-10-29; a second card of the same brand costs 500 baht a year, which the game doesn't track); a cash advance 3% of the amount; spending in another currency at most 2.0%, written as 2.0; no late payment fee and no returned-cheque fee (written by leaving them out), but a collection charge of 50 baht for a debt one cycle overdue and 100 for more, which isn't written. Fees and charges are before VAT, whose rate the table doesn't state. The corporate, commercial and government-services cards aren't written.
